authority: Overall template accepted with corrections. Implementation rules in docs/design/approved-ui-r3-r4.md take precedence over generated pixels.

shared.icons: Structural field/disclosure glyphs and chevrons: neutral onSurfaceVariant. Ordinary toolbar glyphs: one shared contrast-protected neutral onSurface/onSurfaceVariant content role across matching screens. Actions/focus/explicit selection: theme primary. Category/status: documented independent role with text.
shared.keyboard: One Save footer above the IME; scrollable form excludes footer height; focused Title/Notes/caret stays visible; apply keyboard/safe-area insets exactly once.

intentional: Green plant badge identifies the reminder category.
Green Scheduled chip represents confirmed scheduling, not guaranteed sound.
Done is the primary action; Postpone alert is a separate secondary action.

corrections.observed: Alarm icon is orange while When, List and Notes are gray.
corrections.resolve: Use neutral onSurfaceVariant for every structural information icon, including Alarm.

corrections.observed: Postpone alert appears bright red; Done is burnt orange.
corrections.resolve: Use the same Sunrise primary token for Postpone text/outline and the filled Done action. Reserve error/destructive red for those roles.

corrections.observed: Header is taller than the other secondary screenshots; Schedule details uses a list glyph.
corrections.resolve: Use the shared compact header and one Schedule details disclosure glyph/component. Artwork crops instead of changing form geometry.

checks: Keep linked Due concise; do not recreate redundant deadline rows.
Use shared 56dp primary and >=48dp action targets, with actual type and contrast checks.

intentional: Warning-colored Overdue and Due refer to unfinished work; the future postponed alert does not clear them.
Periwinkle Postpone alert and Done represent the Night action accent.
Event and Due remain unchanged after postponement.

corrections.observed: Alarm icon is blue while other structural icons are muted.
corrections.resolve: Make Alarm neutral like When, Due, List and Notes. Tint the Postpone action, not the mode-identification icon.

corrections.observed: List lacks the chevron used in ordinary details; Done is more pill-shaped.
corrections.resolve: Use the same List navigation row and 16dp primary-button radius in both appearances; show a chevron only when the row opens a destination.

corrections.observed: Field alignment/icon tiles and Schedule details glyph differ from Light.
corrections.resolve: Share component anatomy and disclosure glyph across appearances; add a consequential Due row based on data, not theme.

checks: Show original Event Today 4–4:30 PM, overdue Due Today 5 PM, and postponed Next alert Tomorrow 9 AM distinctly.
Do not infer missing timing/status text or active ringing from the illustration.

intentional: Focused Title outline/caret and Save use the Sunrise action accent.
Save moves above the keyboard; List and Notes can be below the scroll viewport.
The user's keyboard controls its own key colors, suggestions and layout.

corrections.observed: Date, Time and Alarm icons are orange, but Repeat is gray.
corrections.resolve: Make all generic form icons and chevrons neutral. Use primary only for focus, selection and actions.

corrections.observed: A single screenshot shows Title focused; it does not demonstrate lower-field visibility.
corrections.resolve: Keep Save outside the form scroll, inside the IME-aware region. Reduce the scroll viewport by the measured footer and bring any focused input/caret above it.

checks: Focus Notes near the bottom with keyboard open; type, select and move the caret through long text without overlap.
Save remains tappable on the first deliberate tap; no duplicate toolbar Save or double keyboard padding.
Test 200% text, larger keyboards/emoji panel, validation errors and keyboard show/hide.

intentional: Independent Due and alert values remain visible separately from Event.
Existing Notes remain expanded; Save is the primary action.
Independent describes timing relationships, not a selected control.

corrections.observed: Nearly all field icons, chevrons, labels and relationship summaries are blue; Back differs from Night details.
corrections.resolve: Use neutral navigation/field glyphs and supporting text consistently. Reserve Night primary for Save, actual focus and explicit selections.

corrections.observed: Independent badges look like accent-colored selection pills.
corrections.resolve: Use the shared neutral relationship-badge style. Color cannot imply that independent timing is an active selected control.

checks: Preserve Event Tomorrow 9–9:30 AM, independent Due 11 AM, independent alert 8:45 AM.
Apply the same keyboard/caret/Notes requirements when this editing screen receives focus.
Use shared card, field, icon-tile and button geometry; typography grows and scrolls.
